lead_headline: Restaurant tracker logged 5 weekend leads including Sandomi at Edgewater, Marczyk FineBurger, Mother Other vegan debut; subscriptions net +2 since Friday amid churn volatility

restaurant.blurb: 5 new leads since Friday — Sandomi (Japanese sandos, Edgewater), Marczyk FineBurger (Northfield), Mother Other (vegan, Baker), PHO & WOK (Evans), Blossom by SYC (LoHi). Closures: Pizzeria Lui (10 years), Church & Union Denver.

liquor.blurb: Third straight zero-application day — unprecedented three-day drought confirms post-backlog normalization is complete. Week ended at 8 total applications vs. prior week's 152, marking sustained 95% volume collapse. No status changes or removals detected over weekend. Pattern now entrenched: single-digit weekly baseline replacing June's triple-digit clearance anomaly. Sporadic filing activity signals return to normal operational cadence.

reputation.blurb: 76 mentions this week across 13 sources, up 13% from prior week's 67 and extending growth to three consecutive weeks. Instagram led at 34 citations (45% share), followed by Reddit (11), Denver Post/Facebook (9 each). Weekend highlights: Westminster Mall nostalgia piece, Drew Barrymore/Chef Geiger culinary feature, RiNo sauna closure, FBI e-bike retailer seizures. Week averaged 10.9 mentions/day vs. prior period's 9.6. Year-to-date tally reaches 1,145 mentions from 108 total sources.

subscriptions.blurb: Net +2 since Friday (7 new, 5 canceled) — weekend brought modest acquisition relief after Saturday's flat performance. MTD sinks deeper to −30 (−1.2/day) as July erosion continues unabated. 90-day net holds at +81. Weekend showed bifurcated pattern: Friday +2, Saturday 0, but aggregate 7-new acquisition over two days matches late-June weekly lows and signals persistent demand fragility despite controlled churn. YTD +196 (+0.9/day) intact but July's −1.3/day drag now entering fourth week.
